sets.name: Uroda
sets.dek: Six groups of one surname — three at Karlobag, one dead man of Šibenik, and a soldier's family at Drniš and another at Betina. Only the top lane is ours, and the joins between the others are drawn dotted because no document makes them.

lanes.label: Karlobag — Georgius × Maria (ours)
lanes.conf: DOCUMENTED FROM 1763 · HIS BAPTISM, HIS PARENTS AND THEIR MARRIAGE NOT FOUND
nodes: Georgius and Maria Uroda are godparents to a child of Paulus and Ursula Smojver — the first sight of them in a register

Joannes Dominicus, their first child, baptised — godfather ANTONIO BARACH «OF ŠIBENIK» and Vincentia, wife of Joannes Margvart (re-read at 3x, 11 October 2026); the name Dominicus is the argument that Georgius's father was a Dominicus
Eight children in the index: Dominicus 1764, Petrus Jacobus 1767, Heva Joanna 1769, Maria Catharina 1772, Heva 1773, Joannes Georgius 1777, Anton Joannis 1780, Joannes 1784
Joannes Georgius baptised — ahnentafel 54, with both parents named
Dominus Georgius Uroda dies and is buried in his own crypt before the church doors — no age given
Georgius, son of the late Georgius, marries Maria Gerkacs (ahnentafel 54 × 55)
Matia baptised, ahnentafel 27 — whose daughter Matia Pilipić (13) is the mother of Josip Papić
ends: Matia Uroda (27) → Matia Pilipić (13) → Josip Papić (6) → Milka (3) → Hedviga (1)
Joannes, the 1784 child, married Maria Barletich in 1806; a Joannes Uroda × Maria baptise at Karlobag in 1810–11. Probably the same couple, not proved
His first child's godfather, Antonio Barach, is «of Šibenik» — a thread to the Dalmatian town, not a descent

lanes.label: Karlobag — Dume Uroda «alias Kovaca» × Eva, then Jerolina
lanes.conf: DOCUMENTED 1733–1750 · BAPTISM, PARENTS, MARRIAGES NOT FOUND · BY-NAME KOVAČ · LINK TO GEORGIUS NOT PROVED
nodes: Antona baptised to «Sime [or Dume?] Uroda» and Eva — the index reads Sime, the first letter is not firm
A child, Dominico as read, to «Dume Uroda alias Kovaca» — a smith's by-name — and Eva; first read as «Horaca», re-read at 3x as «kovaca»
Eva is godmother, «xena Dume urode» — one Eva, 1733 to 1739
Franica, daughter of Dume Uroda and Eva
Jerolina is his wife; a son in 1742 (name ends «Juria»), Giakova (Jakov) on 10 May 1744 as the index reads him, Marta on 11 Aug 1745, Lucia on 17 Dec 1746
A witness at marriages about ten times, and the parish's commonest godparent with Jerolina
Jerolima is «udova … Dume Uroda» — he died between December 1748 and April 1750 (no filmed death book)
Magdalena (1755) and Maria (1767, «of the late Dominicus») marry — daughters of a Dominicus Uroda, probably his
ends: The 1742 son «… Juria» might be Georgius, and a Jure Uroda is godfather beside Dume's widow in 1752 — neither shows it

lanes.label: Šibenik — Dume Uroda, dead by 1739; a Dominicus Uroda and his son Joannes, 1756–1767
lanes.conf: DOCUMENTED IN TWO SEPARATE LINES · NO LINK BETWEEN THEM · NO LINK TO KARLOBAG
nodes: Dume Uroda «od Šibenika» — Dalmatia — nothing else is known of him
Martin Svjata marries Simona, «pokoi[nog] Dume urode od Šibenika» — daughter of the late Dume Uroda of Šibenik
A witness at a marriage in the Dolac parish (S. Marci in Suburbio Maris), Šibenik: «praesentibus testibus Dominico Uroda et Michaele Cigo» — the first Uroda met in the Šibenik registers
«testibus Joseph Fevetti, et Joanne filio Dominici Uroda» — a son of a Dominicus Uroda, of an age to witness
«Magistro Domico [Dominico] Uroda, et Antonio Lucenti» — a master of a trade, Dolac parish
«Illmo Domino Angelo Semonich alias Perova, et Dno Dominico Uroda» — with the honorific, Dolac parish
«coram Testibus Matthaeo Xeravizza, et Dno Dominico Uroda» — cathedral parish (S. Benedicti)
ends: Georgius Uroda (ahnentafel 108) named his first son Dominicus in 1764 (a custom that points to a paternal grandfather of that name), and Dominicus Uroda of Šibenik has a son Joannes — but nothing read says Georgius is his son, nor that he came from Šibenik; a lead, not a link

The living Dume of Karlobag has a wife and baptises children in the same years, so he is a different man from the dead Dume of Šibenik; Dume and Dominicus are the same name, and none of the three is joined to another

lanes.label: Drniš — Caporal Pompeo Uroda × Maria Anna Bachi (soldiers)
lanes.conf: DOCUMENTED ON THE PAGES, 1770–1780 · THE 1771 ENTRY STILL INDEX ONLY · A SOLDIER'S HOUSEHOLD · NO TIE TO KARLOBAG SHOWN
nodes: Josepha, born 1 March — «Pampao Uroda» and Mariana Bachi, «Militum», godparents also soldiers (Franciscan Fr. Josephus Jakick)
Dominica Oliva — the index reads «Ganpas» and Mariana Baich; the page not yet opened
Julia Magdalena — «Caporal Pompeo Uroda» and Maria Anna Bachi; the godfather a Serdar
Joseph — «Domino Caporal Pompeo Uroda» and Domina Maria Anna Bauchi; the index misreads the father as Tomaso

lanes.label: Betina — Simeone Uroda and his sons
lanes.conf: DOCUMENTED ON THE PAGE FOR 1835 · NINETEENTH CENTURY · NO ORIGIN WRITTEN · NOT KNOWN TO TOUCH KARLOBAG
nodes: Maria, daughter of Pietro «Urodan» and Domenica Cucia
Andrea baptised 28 Nov — Simeone Uroda and Giovanna Barran, both «a Betina»; the printed Italian birth register of the Šibenik district (page read)
Simeone and Giovanna have children (Ghelttrada 1847, Andriana 1853, Giocomo 1854); Antonio × Anna 1849, Giovanni × Chetanina Magapin 1850
ends: «Simeone» is the commonest first name here, and the 1733 index line at Karlobag reads «Sime» Uroda — the same sort of name, not the same man

unplaced: Anna Catharina 1805 and Josephus 1807 in the index; Antonio Uroda has no known father. Probably from the Dume or Georgius line, but nothing read says which
Francisca 1794 and Vincentia Maria Anna in the index; the death index buries a «Uroda Petrus»
Jacobus Philippus 1826; named for the Dominicus of the 1750s, whom nothing joins
Maria Francisca 1843 — a Georgius of the next generation after ahnentafel 54
loose: Son of Antonio Uroda and Antonia Budek; the place is not stated in the index line seen
Michael Marianus Uroda, b. 1874, married Rosa Sinković — «Croazia», no parish seen
sets.note: One spelling is not a search. The registers write Uroda, urode, vrode, Urodan, Urada; the index reads one Karlobag father as Sime, spells Dume's children Urode (so a search for Uroda misses them), and reads one Drniš father four ways (Janpao, Ganpas, Pompio, Tomaso) where the pages say Pampao and Pompeo. At Karlobag in 1734 a priest writes «Dume urode alliti Kovaca» — a by-name, a smith's — and before the 1730s the book has no Uroda at all, so a baptism of the man himself would sit under another surname. See The Second Name.
sets.owes: For Uroda that is: Dume's baptism (likely under the by-name Kovač, in the 1700s), the marriage of Georgius and Maria (not in Karlobag's marriage book 1736–1804, not in the index under any «Urod*» spelling, not in the Šibenik cathedral marriage book 1752–1770 nor the Dolac parish marriage book 1752–1764, both read entry by entry; perhaps Varoš before 1764, whose book begins only that year, or a place not filmed), Maria's maiden name (Barach, of Šibenik, is the best candidate — her first child's godfather), and the Šibenik baptisms themselves, above all a Georgius or a Joannes «filius Dominici Uroda» in the Dolac, cathedral or Varoš baptism books, which would say whose son Georgius is (the Betina and Drniš ones have been opened and are other families).

sets.name: Smojver
sets.dek: At Karlobag the name is written in two ways, with and without the by-name «Vukić», and a second large body of the exact spelling sits at Cesarica. Only the Vukić line is ours; the others are drawn apart until a register joins them.

lanes.label: Karlobag — Smojver called «Vukić» (ours)
lanes.conf: DOCUMENTED 1754–1798 · THE FATHER'S BAPTISM (1731) NOT YET READ
nodes: Josiph Smojver, called Vukić, born (the tree's year; his baptism is on the Karlobag films and not yet read)
Vicentius Fabianus Smojver Vukić born — ahnentafel 106
Vincentius Smojver «Vukich» marries Oliva, daughter of the late Caetanus Bacchi (ahnentafel 106 × 107)
Josephus Smojver, called Vukcich, dies aged 45 — ahnentafel 212
Oliva Maria baptised, daughter of Vincentius Smojver «Vukich» and Oliva — ahnentafel 53
Josephus Pilepich, widower, marries Maria, daughter of Vincentius — probably Oliva Maria
ends: Oliva Maria (53) → Vicko Pilipić (26) → Matia (13) → Josip Papić (6) → Milka → Hedviga

lanes.label: Karlobag — Paulus Smojver × Ursula (no «Vukić» written)
lanes.conf: DOCUMENTED IN TWO ENTRIES, 1763 AND 1780 · THE HOUSEHOLD NOT FOLLOWED
nodes: Carolus baptised, son of Paulus and Ursula Smojver; Georgius and Maria Uroda are the godparents
Vitus baptised, son of Paulo and Barbara Smojver, «hujus Civitatis» — Paulus again, with a wife Barbara where 1763 has Ursula
ends: Neither entry writes «Vukić»; whether Paulus belongs to that house is not shown

lanes.label: Cesarica — Smojver, 1810–1858 (index only)
lanes.conf: INDEX ONLY · 138 LINES UNDER THE EXACT SPELLING · NOT OPENED · NO TIE TO KARLOBAG SHOWN
nodes: The earliest of 138 index lines at Cesarica under the exact spelling «Smojver»
The latest — the index runs to 1858 there
ends: A village a short way up the coast from Karlobag; the same name, in the same district

unplaced: Early Smojver households at Karlobag, 1718–1746 (index only)

Duim Smojver baptises Marta 1718, Jakov 1721, Martha 1725 and Anica 1735; Marko in 1729; an Osip Smojver and Franica baptise Francisko on 25 Oct 1733; Pavle and Anica baptise Marica in 1737; Morko, Adam in 1746. Households of the name before the «Vukić» Josiph (b. about 1731) and Paulus (1763) — none shown to be his parents. The Osip of 1733 cannot be the Josiph who died aged 45 in 1776
Smojver at Vitipolis, Jablanac, Fiume and Senj, 1845–1906
Forty-odd index lines in later decades, all after 1845: households that moved, probably out of the Karlobag–Cesarica stock, but not shown to
sets.note: Why two lanes at Karlobag. The tree's Smojver are called Vukić in the marriage of 1774 and the baptism of 1781 («Smojver Vukich»), and the 1776 death says «called Vukcich». The Paulus Smojver who baptises in 1763 is written without it. A by-name marks which house of a surname is meant (see The Second Name), so the two are kept apart until something says Paulus is a Vukić too.
sets.owes: For Smojver that is: Josiph's baptism of 1731, whether Paulus is a Vukić, and whether the Cesarica Smojver came from Karlobag or the other way (the Cesarica index lines begin in 1810 and the Karlobag ones in 1768, which may only mean that Cesarica's books are indexed from 1810).

sets.name: Pilipić
sets.dek: The name is written Pilepich, Pilipich and Pilipić, and the index has it by the thousand in the Rijeka–Kastav area and at «Vitipolis». Only the Karlobag line of Jacobus, captain of the port, is ours.

lanes.label: Karlobag — Jacobus Pilepich, captain of the port (ours)
lanes.conf: DOCUMENTED FROM 1747 · NO PILIPIĆ BAPTISM AT KARLOBAG BEFORE 1739 · ORIGIN UNPROVED, KASTAV THE CANDIDATE
nodes: A Jakov (Jakomo) Pilipić baptises a Jakov at Karlobag — the first Pilipić in a Karlobag baptism (index); the captain's marriage to Katta is 1747, his children 1748–56 (Matia Simuna, Lucia, Maria Vicenza, Andria Mikula, Karla Adelbrand) — read from the page: godparents the gentry (Zorović; the wife of Antun Dorliga), no mother named
Jakov Pilepich marries Katta, daughter of the late Vicko Luckinich
Jacobus Pilepich, captain of the port, buried in his own crypt — ahnentafel 104
Catharina, aged 70, widow of the late Jacob Pilepich — ahnentafel 105
Josephus Pilepich, widower, marries Maria, daughter of Vincentius (probably Oliva Maria Smojver)
Matthea baptised, daughter of the chamber shipmaster Vincentius Pilipich and Mathea Uroda — ahnentafel 13
ends: Vicko Pilepić (26) dies at Senj in 1897, a retired financial guard; his daughter's line is Papić

Two Jacobus Pilepich were baptised at Kastav: 5 Jul 1705 (son of Georgius and Ursula) and 25 Jun 1708 (son of Martin and Margarita). Either would be 39–42 at the 1747 marriage — a candidate for the captain, index only, no Karlobag entry names his origin

unplaced: Jakov Pilipić, father of a Jakov baptised 30 Nov 1739
Older than the captain's own children (1748–56): the captain himself with an earlier marriage, or his father or brother. Not read from the page
Pilepich at Vitipolis, 1737–1892 (107 index lines under this spelling)
The largest body of the name in the index; not opened, no tie to Karlobag shown
Over a hundred lines at Fiume and fifty at Kastav; the name is old here (1620s) — an older stock than the Karlobag one
Lika and Slavonia households; nothing links them to the Karlobag captain
Eighteen lines at Senj before Vicko Pilepić arrives there
sets.note: Why only one lane. The index has well over a thousand lines of the name, but every cluster outside Karlobag is a body of index lines, not a family anyone has followed. They are listed below the figure as not yet on any lane rather than drawn as families: a lane is a household the registers show, and these have not been shown.
sets.owes: For Pilipić that is: the captain's baptism (not at Karlobag: the index has no Pilipić baptism there before 1739, and 1700–1730 holds none under any spelling — so probably at Kastav or Rijeka, where two Jacobus Pilepich of 1705 and 1708 are the candidates), whether the Jakov of 1739 is he, and a second family of the name at Karlobag before anyone is called a stranger to it.

sets.name: Bacchi
sets.dek: A rare name, and the one with the best lead on this site: a Caietanus Bachi baptised at Pag in 1728, the son of a patrician, who may be the Caetanus who married at Karlobag in 1753.

lanes.conf: DOCUMENTED 1753–1774 · HIS ORIGIN NOT NAMED IN ANY KARLOBAG ENTRY

«Caietan Bachi» and his wife Anna stand sponsors
Anna, widow of Caetanus Bachi, marries Paulus Perpich — he is dead by then
Oliva, daughter of the late Caetanus Bacchi, marries Vincentius Smojver «Vukich» — ahnentafel 107

Caietanus Antonius Gregorius baptised, son of Dno Angelo Bachi, Patricio, and Dna Oliva — read from the page

lanes.label: Karlobag — Angelo Bachi × Catharina (1779)
lanes.conf: DOCUMENTED IN ONE ENTRY · THE TREE'S ANGELO COMES FROM HERE ONLY · NOT SHOWN TO BE RELATED TO CAETANUS
nodes: Caetanus Antonius baptised, son of Angelo and Catharina Bachi — godparents the Captain Joannes Jankovich and Maria, wife of Dno Georgius Uroda
ends: Caetanus Antonius is the Pag child's name of 1728 almost exactly; a family naming a boy after a dead uncle or father would do that — a question, not a finding

lanes.label: Drniš — Mariana Bachi, wife of Caporal Pompeo Uroda
lanes.conf: DOCUMENTED ON THE PAGES, 1770–1780 · SHE IS A SOLDIER'S WIFE
nodes: Mariana Bachi and Pampao Uroda, «Militum», baptise Josepha
Maria Anna Bachi and Caporal Pompeo Uroda
Domina Maria Anna Bauchi and Caporal Pompeo Uroda
ends: A Dalmatian town and a Dalmatian garrison; the same rare name, nothing more

loose: Ten index lines in the Podravina — a different stock of the name, far inland
sets.note: What the 1728 page does and does not say. It names a child Caietanus Antonius ac Gregorius, born 12 March 1728, to Dno Angelo Bachi, Patricio and Dna Oliva, at Pag. On the Karlobag side everything is circumstance — the rare name, the age, a daughter called Oliva like the Pag mother. And the tree's Angelo (ahnentafel 428) is not evidence: he and his Catharina come only from a different baptism, of 12 January 1779, of a Caetanus Antonius at Karlobag whose godmother is Maria Uroda — a second Bachi household in the town, which the tree has wrongly welded onto the elder Caetanus. So the Pag baptism is a candidate, strong and unproved, and the 1779 household a separate lane.
sets.owes: For Bacchi that is: a Karlobag entry that names Caetanus's father or his town (the marriage of 1753 does not), his death before October 1760 (Karlobag's death book begins in 1774, so that is not filmed), and the Pag baptisms of his siblings read from the pages, not the index.
